name: crypto.rsa
doc:
RSA key generation (the signature and OAEP primitives are runtime
functions, crypto/rsa.c). Primes come from the runtime (random
candidates with the top two bits set, trial division, Miller-Rabin);
the key arithmetic uses math.big.

items.name: DecryptOAEP
items.signature: func DecryptOAEP(key []byte, hash string, ciphertext []byte, label []byte) []byte!
items.doc: DecryptOAEP decrypts OAEP ciphertext with a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey (DER).
items.summary: DecryptOAEP decrypts OAEP ciphertext with a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey (DER).

items.name: EncryptOAEP
items.signature: func EncryptOAEP(n []byte, e []byte, hash string, msg []byte, label []byte) []byte!
items.doc: EncryptOAEP encrypts msg for the public key (n, e) with OAEP and hash.
items.summary: EncryptOAEP encrypts msg for the public key (n, e) with OAEP and hash.

items.name: GenerateKey
items.doc:
Generates a key of `bits` bits (2048, 3072 or 4096; at least 1024) with
e = 65537, as a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER (the form SignPKCS1v15,
SignPSS and DecryptOAEP take).
items.summary: Generates a key of `bits` bits (2048, 3072 or 4096; at least 1024) with e = 65537, as a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER (the form SignPKCS1v15, SignPSS and DecryptOAEP take).

items.name: IsProbablePrime
items.doc: IsProbablePrime runs Miller-Rabin with rounds bases on big-endian p (variable time).
items.summary: IsProbablePrime runs Miller-Rabin with rounds bases on big-endian p (variable time).

items.name: PublicKeyOf
items.doc: The public key of a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER.
items.summary: The public key of a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER.

items.name: SignPKCS1v15
items.doc: SignPKCS1v15 signs digest with a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey (DER).
items.summary: SignPKCS1v15 signs digest with a PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey (DER).

items.name: SignPSS
items.doc: SignPSS signs digest with PSS (salt length = hash length).
items.summary: SignPSS signs digest with PSS (salt length = hash length).

items.name: VerifyPKCS1v15
items.signature: func VerifyPKCS1v15(n []byte, e []byte, hash string, digest []byte, sig []byte) bool
items.doc: VerifyPKCS1v15 reports whether sig is a PKCS#1 v1.5 signature of digest for the public key (n, e; big-endian).
items.summary: VerifyPKCS1v15 reports whether sig is a PKCS#1 v1.5 signature of digest for the public key (n, e; big-endian).

items.name: VerifyPSS
items.signature: func VerifyPSS(n []byte, e []byte, hash string, digest []byte, sig []byte) bool
items.doc: VerifyPSS reports whether sig is a PSS signature of digest (MGF1 with the same hash, any salt length).
items.summary: VerifyPSS reports whether sig is a PSS signature of digest (MGF1 with the same hash, any salt length).

items.name: PublicKey
items.doc: An RSA public key: modulus and exponent as big-endian bytes.
items.summary: An RSA public key: modulus and exponent as big-endian bytes.
